summary: Correctly resolves the bpo-43882 regression by rejecting URLs containing LF/CR/tab before splitting, matching Django's actual recommended fix and using the same '\t\r\n' character set. No correctness, regression, or compatibility problems; only minor stylistic differences from the idiomatic frozenset approach.

issues.description: Django's real fix stores forbidden chars as a frozenset class attribute (e.g. unsafe_chars = frozenset('\t\r\n')) and uses set intersection. Inline tuple + any() generator works but is slightly less idiomatic for the codebase.
any(char in value for ...) scans the string up to 3 times; a single set-intersection pass would be marginally cheaper. Negligible at URL-validation scale, not merge-blocking.
Comment 'forbidden characters' is generic; a short note tying it to bpo-43882 / why these chars matter would aid future maintainers. Optional.
